name: Research review
about: Report an error, a gap, missing prior art or a failed replay in a result
title: "[review] <result folder>: <one-line summary>"
labels: research-review

## Which result and commit

- Result folder (for example `results/cab6-packing`):
- Commit reviewed:
- Statement or step in question (quote it or give the section of `PROOF.md`):

## Kind of finding

- [ ] Mathematical error or gap in a proof
- [ ] A finite check does not support the stated claim (range, tolerance or hypothesis too weak)
- [ ] The replay fails or the certificate changes (`make verify`, Python version, platform)
- [ ] Prior art that the repository does not cite
- [ ] Label is too strong or too weak (PROVEN / VERIFIED / KNOWN / NEW-COMPUTATION / CONJECTURE; definitions in `docs/audit.md`)
- [ ] Other
